title: Ian Fleming's MI6 mission to evacuate Martin Bormann

tellings.quote: So Ian Fleming, who went on to write the Bond novels, was an MI6 operative whose specific mission at the end of the war was to facilitate the evacuation of Martin Borman to Argentina.

plain: Ian Fleming, who later wrote the James Bond novels, was an agent of MI6, Britain's foreign intelligence service, and his specific mission at the end of the Second World War in 1945 was to help Martin Bormann, Hitler's top aide, escape to Argentina. The researcher Jason Jorjani tells Michels this without naming a source. If true, it would mean Britain secretly helped a leading Nazi flee.
